sourceIssues.locator: Proposition 8.6, displayed formula, in arXiv 2010.00657v3 (5 September 2022; the authors' final version, source dated 14 May 2022) and in the 14 May 2022 PDF on M. Kakde's homepage, p.52. The February 2022 version on S. Dasgupta's homepage (p.53) does not have it. The published version, Annals of Mathematics 197 (2023), 289–388, could not be checked (paywalled).
sourceIssues.printed: "For a cusp [𝒜] ∈ C₀(𝔠, 𝔫), the normalized constant term c_𝒜(0, W_k(ψ_𝔓, 1)) equals 𝔱 · τ(ψ)/N𝔠₀^k · sgn(N(−c)) ψ(𝔠_𝒜) · L(ψ^{−1}, 1−k)/2^n · ∏_{𝔭|𝔓}(1 − ψ(𝔭)/N𝔭^k) · ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱}(1 − ψ(𝔩)) · ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱^c}(1 − N𝔩^k)."
sourceIssues.correction: Delete the leading 𝔱: c_𝒜(0, W_k(ψ_𝔓, 1)) = τ(ψ)/N𝔠₀^k · sgn(N(−c)) ψ(𝔠_𝒜) · L(ψ^{−1}, 1−k)/2^n · ∏_{𝔭|𝔓}(1 − ψ(𝔭)/N𝔭^k) · ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱}(1 − ψ(𝔩)) · ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔱^c}(1 − N𝔩^k).
sourceIssues.reason: 𝔱 is an integral ideal (the auxiliary modulus of §8.1), not a scalar, so the printed product has no meaning. The proof computes the constant term as the displayed expression with Σ_{𝔪|𝔱} μ(𝔪) ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔪^c} N𝔩^k ∏_{𝔩∈J_𝔪} ψ(𝔩) in place of the last two products, and evaluates that sum by the Möbius identity; no factor 𝔱 appears. The February 2022 version prints the formula without it (with 𝔮 for 𝔩). Checked on the page images of both author versions and in the arXiv v3 source (`\ft` at the start of the display). Noted by the extraction (item 221).
